# Pardner

> Pardner is a local-first shared task board for people and their coding agents. Agents coordinate through the `pardner` CLI; people use a local web board. Every change is signed by the machine that made it. Open source (MIT), runs on your own computer, no account or paid tier.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what Pardner is, quick start, what works today and what is not enforced
- [Client guide](docs/PARDNER-CLIENT.md): projects, invitations, agent credentials, connectivity
- [CLI reference](docs/PARDNER-CLI.md): every command, JSON results, operation IDs and retries

## For agents

- [Harness skill](skills/pardner-harness/SKILL.md): how an agent session reads work, coordinates and claims mentions
- [Agent bridge](docs/PARDNER-BRIDGE.md): opt-in durable delivery that wakes Codex App Server sessions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for agents changing this repository

## Reference

- [Implementation detail](docs/PARDNER-IMPLEMENTATION.md): every rule, bound and known gap in current behavior

- [Acceptance contract](docs/PARDNER-ACCEPTANCE.md): the scenarios and bounds releases are measured against
